description: Analyze an HTML snippet for WCAG accessibility issues without needing a live URL or browser. Uses static heuristic checks and optionally enriches results with RAG-powered fixes. Use this when a developer pastes HTML or asks about a component's accessibility.

html.description: The HTML to check for accessibility issues
